# Crux IDE

Crux is a collaborative code editor with a spatial canvas for exploring connected files, real-time shared editing, and an integrated terminal. The browser IDE is available at https://codecrux.us/ide; desktop access is in waitlist preview.

## Main pages
- [Homepage](https://codecrux.us/)
- [Try the browser IDE](https://codecrux.us/ide)
- [Compare coding tools](https://codecrux.us/compare)
- [Documentation](https://codecrux.us/docs)
- [Join the desktop waitlist](https://codecrux.us/#waitlist)

## Notes
Crux is an evolving product. Quantitative performance or competitor benchmark results are not published here without reproducible measurements.
